scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && eslint src/
scripts.version: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('manifest.json')); m.version=process.env.npm_new_version; fs.writeFileSync('manifest.json', JSON.stringify(m, null, '\t'));" && npm run changelog && git add manifest.json CHANGELOG.md
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json manifest.json && git commit -m "chore: bump minor version"
scripts.release:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json manifest.json && git commit -m "chore: bump major version"
